description: This file defines application route constants and a route-building function for a Flutter app. It includes route names, a list of all routes, and a scaffold widget used as placeholders for the different pages during development.

classes.name: _PlaceholderScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget used as a placeholder for different screens, displaying a title and navigation button, primarily for development and testing of the routing system.

methods.name: buildAppRoutes
methods.description: Creates a map of route names to widget builders, linking route constants to placeholder screen widgets.
